theme.mode: light by default — the app; the navy set kept whole under [data-theme="dark"] for the marketing routes and an admin's explicit opt-in
theme.brand_navy_role: headings, primary buttons, inverse chrome (the admin sidebar) — navy is not retired, it inverts
theme.brand_red_role: the accent: fills, bars, dots, badge grounds, borders, the logo, standout data. As text below 24px it is #C41E27 (accent-ink), never #FF2731

light.control_border: #D8D2C8 (1.50:1 on white — below the 3:1 WCAG asks of a control boundary; kept as specified and flagged)
light.muted: #8A93A1 (3.10:1 on white, 2.83:1 on the ground — decoration only, never text)
light.accent: #FF2731 (3.76:1 on white — fills and boundaries only)
light.accent_ink: #C41E27 (5.90:1 on white — the only red on text below 24px)

states.warn: #9E6000 on #FDF3E0 (darkened from #B06B00, which is 3.85:1 on its own wash)

inverse.used_for: the admin sidebar and its phone sheet

dark.cta_label: #091426 (white on the red is 3.76:1 and fails AA)

theme.source_of_truth: frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js. This file follows the code, not the other way round. backend/tests/unit/test_brand.py computes every contrast figure from the shipped tokens.

rules: CRITICAL: BANNED LIST - Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans or Lato for headings. Headings are Fraunces (font-serif). Inter Tight is the body face and is not covered by this.
Headlines (Size > 32px): MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels: MUST be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
H1 (Hero/Main Heading): MAXIMUM text-6xl (clamp/fluid scaling). Do not use text-7xl, text-8xl, or text-9xl.
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Load exactly one font stylesheet, the @import at the top of src/index.css. public/index.html must not load a second one.
typography.source_of_truth: tailwind.config.js and src/index.css. This file follows the code, not the other way round.

colors.notation: HSL triplets in CSS custom properties, read through hsl(var(--x)). The two translucent washes carry their alpha inside the token.
colors.light_is_root: Every token is defined on :root for the light app and redefined under [data-theme="dark"]. [data-surface="light"|"dark"|"inverse"] scopes a band or a chrome element.
strategy: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule survives: no pure #000 ink. Ground and lines are warm (hue ~37); ink is navy-tinted (hue ~217).
Red has two tokens because it has two jobs: --accent for anything that is not a word, --accent-ink for any word below 24px.
Primary buttons are navy with white text — never red — on the light app.
A state is ink on its own wash, and is never the accent red.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant): Use for Sticky Headers/Navs. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10 (1px delicate inner stroke).
Neumorphism (Tactile): Use for Dashboard Cards. Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift, subtle shadow, border brightens.
decorations: Textures: Apply subtle grain or noise overlays to break digital flatness.
Max Overlay Opacity for Hero Images: bg-black/50. If image isn't visible, overlay is too heavy. Prefer gradient overlay vs blanket flat overlay.

component_rules.forms_and_inputs: ALWAYS use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox (HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE them to strip the 'Vercel-look' via Tailwind).
component_rules.buttons: Primary is navy (#091426) with white text. Secondary is the card with a control border. Pills are rounded-pill.
component_rules.cards: Cards are white on the warm ground, separated by the hairline, not by shadow. Radius from the scale: sm 10px · md 14px · lg 20px · xl 22px · pill 999px. `rounded` (4px) is kept for controls too small to carry 10px — a 16px checkbox.
component_rules.navigation: A visible bar on desktop. The admin sidebar is inverse chrome — navy, light ink — via data-surface="inverse".
component_rules.calendar_dropdowns: Use Shadcn calendar and dropdown-menu. DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>.

spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6, p-8) to prevent collision.
Tailwind Scale: Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32 for section padding.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_marketing: MODE A (Tetris Grid): Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave negative space.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_dashboard: MODE B (High Density Grid): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
alignment: Never center everything by default. Use explicit alignment and hierarchy. Left-align dense content and paragraphs.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

rules: Hover states (all interactive elements): explicit color shifts. E.g., hover:text-white hover:bg-orange-600.
DO NOT use universal transition (transition-all). Target specific properties: transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200.

contrast: When placing text over images/gradients, use text shadow to maintain contrast.
interaction: Focus states MUST have HIGHER contrast than default state.

images: Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh (max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none).
Include subjects in scenes for authenticity. Avoid empty, artificial scenes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file entirely and apply the specified font families in `index.css` and `tailwind.config.js`.
2. Setup 'Instrument Serif' for all h1, h2, h3 tags and 'DM Sans' for body text. Enforce tracking and leading rules.
3. Implement the dark mode color scheme. Override Shadcn default Vercel-like styling to match this premium cinematic aesthetic.
4. Build the placeholder Landing page using pure HTML/Tailwind, incorporating the provided images with proper dark gradient overlays.
5. Build the Signup page with Creator vs Brand role selection.
7. Build the Dashboard placeholder shell with a Sidebar/Nav layout, leveraging the Neumorphic tactile card rules.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and backdrop blurs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or over content.

foundations.source_of_truth: frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js. This block describes what is implemented there; the code wins.
grain: One texture, defined once as the --grain-texture custom property in src/index.css.
.grain — the overlay variant: an absolutely-positioned ::before over whatever is beneath, including a photograph. Needs a positioned parent and `absolute inset-0`. Used by the landing hero.

.grain-surface — the surface variant: the texture as a second background layer on the element itself, blended `overlay` against its own background-color. Inherits border-radius, needs no wrapper. Goes on cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers and menus.
.grain-page — the same with `background-attachment: fixed`, on page shells.
.media-frame — reserves an image's space and shows a grained, card-coloured ground until it loads.

NEVER on a translucent surface (bg-card/40): the blend runs against the element's own colour before that colour composites over the page, so at 40% alpha nothing attenuates the noise and the panel lifts from sRGB 13 to about 40. Measured, not guessed.
NEVER on an element with a Tailwind gradient — that sets background-image too, and one of the two wins.
Calibrated rather than eyeballed: over --background (sRGB 11) the ground settles at 12-15; over --card (17) at 17-21.
fluid_type: Display headings use the `text-fluid-*` scale in tailwind.config.js, never a `text-X md:text-Y` pair.
Steps: fluid-3xl (2xl to 3xl), fluid-4xl (3xl to 4xl), fluid-5xl (4xl to 5xl), fluid-5xl-wide (3xl to 5xl), fluid-6xl (5xl to 6xl), fluid-6xl-wide (4xl to 6xl), fluid-hero (2.5rem to 4.25rem).
Each step's clamp minimum and maximum are the exact Tailwind sizes of the pair it replaced, interpolated over a 375px-1280px viewport.
Card titles and other single-size headings (text-xl, text-2xl) stay fixed on purpose: a 24px card title should not grow to 40px on a wide screen.
elevation_on_dark: Elevation is a lighter surface, not a shadow: `hover:bg-card-elevated` (--card-elevated, three points of lightness above --card) plus a brighter hairline border.
Shadows are reserved for what genuinely floats above the page — dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, tooltips, toasts. Nothing inline: no inputs, buttons, badges, switches, cards or tabs.
Floating surfaces are glass: border-white/10, bg-*/95, backdrop-blur-xl, grain-surface, and a shadow in shadow-black rather than the default grey.
Modal overlays are bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-sm rather than a flat bg-black/80 — less of the app is lost behind them.
media: Every image slot declares its ratio. Avatars carry aspect-square alongside their fixed dimensions, so the ratio is stated rather than implied by two numbers somebody has to keep equal.

A full-bleed fill image (absolute inset-0) has no ratio to reserve — the box is sized by its parent. Those get .media-frame for the ground instead; an aspect-ratio there would fight min-h-screen and make the page scroll.
dense_views: The admin console, the campaigns lists, the creator directory, the applicant board and the audit log share one set of primitives: src/components/data/DenseView.jsx.
Sticky: STICKY in that file is the only place the offsets and z-indexes are written. The navbar is sticky top-0 z-40 h-16, so everything below it clears 4rem and sits under z-40.

A filter bar whose controls stack on a phone uses level="headerFromMd" — pinning a 400px column of controls under the navbar leaves a third of an 844px screen for the list it is meant to help you read. Single-row bars (the console's tab strip, the applicant tabs) pin at every width.
A sticky bar bleeds to its container's edges (`-mx-6 px-6`) or the blurred panel stops short and a strip of unblurred list slides past beside it.

Every filtered list carries a ResultCount and FilterChips: one chip per active filter, each removable on its own, plus a clear-all. Sort is not a filter and gets no chip — it changes the order, not the set.

Every list that can be empty uses ListEmptyState, which draws the distinction that matters: 'nothing here yet' (say what would appear, and how to get some) versus 'nothing matches your filters' (offer the clear).
Loading is a skeleton in the shape of the content, never a spinner. Measured: swapping skeleton for content scores 0.0000 CLS at 390px and 1440px.

Tables scroll inside a ScrollTable with the header sticky and the first column pinned — that column is the row's identity. `overflow-x: auto` computes overflow-y to auto as well, which makes the container the scroller, which is why it owns a max-height: a sticky header with nothing to stick against does nothing.
A long free-text cell is line-clamped with the full text on `title`. Unclamped, one audit reason took a row from 64px to 201px on a phone.
radius: The maximum was 8px and is raised to 22px. The scale: sm 10px, md 14px, lg 20px, xl 22px, pill 999px — `rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/pill`, read from --radius-* in index.css.

Why raise it rather than split the difference: the low-density brief is drawn at 20-22px, and a 12px compromise would be a third radius nobody designed to. The dark set keeps 4/6/8 for the marketing pages that were drawn to it.
`rounded` (Tailwind's 4px) stays for controls under ~24px — a checkbox at 10px is a circle.
type_scale: Tokens, never arbitrary sizes: text-eyebrow 11px (uppercase, tracking-eyebrow 0.18em), text-meta 14px, text-body 16px (the document base), text-body-lg 17px, text-h3 24px, text-h2 24→30px, text-h1 32→46px.
h1-h3 are Fraunces 600 with tracking -0.025/-0.015/-0.01em; h1 at line-height 1.05. h1 and h2 clamp between a 375px and 1280px viewport so neither overflows at phone width.
Eyebrows use --muted-foreground (#5B6678). The brief's muted ink (#8A93A1) is 3.10:1 on white and fails AA for text; it is kept as --faint-foreground for decoration only.
The marketing pages keep their fluid poster scale (text-fluid-*); they are on the dark set and out of scope of the move to light.
spacing: card padding p-card-sm 26px / p-card 30px / p-card-lg 34px by prominence; inner card padding p-inner 24px; section gap gap-section/space-y-section 26px; list row padding py-row 22px vertical.
density: Two densities, one component set. data-density="compact" on a wrapper redefines --space-row-y 22→9px, --text-body 16→14px, --text-meta 14→13px, --space-section 26→16px and --row-h 70→42px, and hides .density-avatar. Colours, radii and focus styles are not in that block.

Admin only, and only on the action queue, the console's data tables and the audit log. DensityScope is the one writer; DENSITY_SURFACES is the list; the overview is never on it. test_density.py fails a build that applies it anywhere else.
elevation_on_light: Surfaces separate with the hairline (#E3DED6) and the white card on the warm ground, never with a shadow. Shadows are for what floats: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.
focus: Every interactive element: a 2px ring in --ring with a 2-3px offset, so it clears rounded corners rather than being clipped by them. Navy on light (18.43:1 on white, 16.78:1 on the ground), the inverse ink on navy chrome (16.26:1), red on the dark set (4.90:1).
